answer: To enter the harvest guild, a new key must buy a numbered pearl and walk it through four orchard gates whose lamps flash a unique pulse train lasting 90 seconds. The key locks 64 units and precommits H(pearl_id||gate_times||key). A random pair of keepers, each bonding 29 units, later replay the lamp log: times must sit 18-22s apart, the pearl_id must be unused, and the hash must open. A skipped gate, cloned pearl, or jitter over 3s slashes 25 units and exiles the key for 9 epochs. A keeper rubber-stamping two pearls in one pulse window forfeits the 29-unit bond and sits out 12 epochs.
